response.sql:
WITH per_name AS (
  SELECT r.name,
         AVG(ds.points) AS avg_points,
         COUNT(DISTINCT ds.driverId) AS driver_count
  FROM driverStandings AS ds
  JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId
  GROUP BY r.name
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(driver_count) AS avg_count
  FROM per_name
)
SELECT AVG(p.avg_points),
       AVG(p.driver_count),
       AVG(p.driver_count - o.avg_count)
FROM per_name AS p
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE p.driver_count > o.avg_count;

assumptions.assumption: Each distinct race name is weighted equally when computing the overall average count, as well as in the final averages.
